rules: Preserve null for missing data. Never infer CI/sample size or invent arms.
No curves unless actual IPD or published digitized data explicitly provided; use bars/points with clear metric.
Each resultChart is WITHIN one trial and same endpoint/timepoint/analysis population.
Single arm chart contains one arm only; do not create historical comparator.
n may retain display string to preserve multiple denominators.
Keep original citation links and dates; each quantitative chart must cite exact source.
Return JSON array file; new records use unique lowercase-hyphen id.
